scope: Local catalog text assessment only; no comprehensive-rules, current-legality, or executable-sequence certification.

candidates.summary: With Cleric class bonuses active, gathering triggers Tender damage to both champions; Rebuke can prevent damage to your champion and trigger its damage to an opposing champion.
requirements: A Cleric champion, Tender on the field, a separate gather source, and Rebuke prevention active before damage.
cautions: The two listed cards do not provide gather. Do not infer a repeatable loop or fixed total damage.

candidates.summary: Floral Arrangement summons two Herb tokens that can pay the Brew cost of Combustible Potion. Brewing enables its draw-two/discard-one effect; sacrificing the Potion deals 2 damage to a target unit.
requirements: Resolve Floral Arrangement and retain both tokens until brewing the Potion.
cautions: Sacrificing tokens to Brew does not also activate their printed sacrifice abilities. Summoning these tokens is not itself a printed gather instruction.

candidates.summary: Finale requires banishing two floating-memory cards from the graveyard, which supports Whiplash Allure lash counters. Both cards have champion-hit milling effects.
requirements: Two floating-memory cards already in the graveyard, activation resources, Nico bonus, and a successful champion hit.
cautions: Milling depends on a hit and the relevant counters; co-occurrence cannot establish an automatic win.

candidates.summary: Rapture's Embrace supplies the Nico identity for Finale; its conditional entry effect can put one card into the graveyard.
requirements: Another water card in lineage for the entry effect; two floating-memory cards in the graveyard for Finale, activation resources, and a champion hit.
cautions: The entry effect does not guarantee floating memory and supplies only one card. This pair lacks Whiplash Allure's printed lash-counter engine.

candidates.summary: Monk grants regalia a rest ability dealing 1 damage as a Spell. Awake Psycho increases exactly 1 non-combat damage from your sources by 1; its Lorraine bonus makes your non-combat damage unpreventable.
requirements: Monk on the field, Psycho awake when damage is dealt, and another awake regalia for the granted rest ability. Lorraine is needed for unpreventable damage.
cautions: Resting Psycho itself to pay for the granted ability disables its awake-dependent boost unless it is awake again when damage is dealt.
Its Lorraine-specific material-deck activation needs six arcane cards in banishment and enters rested. Material presence alone does not establish an available awake weapon.

candidates.summary: Two level-2 champions mark a hybrid champion package. Their printed text does not establish a direct two-card sequence.
requirements: A separately established legal champion/lineage route.
cautions: Lorraine, Blademaster requires Lorraine lineage. Do not assume two level-2 champions can simply level into one another or have simultaneous active abilities.

candidates.summary: Advent of the Stormcaller has printed reserve cost 15 and can be a high-cost omen for Baleful Oblation, whose damage uses the lowest reserve cost among your omens.
requirements: An omen-enabling effect; the payload must actually be an omen, and every omen must meet the intended damage floor.
cautions: The pair alone does not create an omen. A cheaper omen lowers the damage; drawing the payload is not equivalent to casting it.
Local catalog marks Baleful Oblation STANDARD limit 0; retain historical evidence and recheck format legality before recommendation.

candidates.summary: Profane Bindings is a non-Skill action with reserve cost 2, within Grim Pastiche's printed copy criteria when it is an omen.
requirements: Profane Bindings established as an omen, access to Grim Pastiche, and a card activation to negate.
cautions: The two cards do not create an omen. Copied-card lineage and inherited-effect handling require rules review before an executable recipe.
Local catalog marks Grim Pastiche STANDARD limit 0.

candidates.summary: Mad Hatter's entry ability can materialize Ranger Strides, a Ranger regalia; Strides draws a card on entry and can grant ranged 4 to a Ranger unit.
requirements: A card available to banish at random from material and Ranger Strides still in material afterward; a distant Ranger for the ranged benefit.
cautions: Random banishment can remove the intended target. This pair contains no wake-up effect.
Local catalog marks Ranger Strides STANDARD limit 0.

candidates.summary: Invective Instruction buffs an ally until end of turn; Second Wind can wake that ally so the temporary buff can support another attack.
requirements: An ally able to attack, remaining resources for Second Wind, and a legal further attack in the same turn.
cautions: The two cards do not supply an ally. Tamer draw and Warrior power bonuses have separate class conditions; neither is automatic.

candidates.summary: Strides grants ranged 4 until end of turn to a Ranger unit; Second Wind can wake a Ranger ally to reuse that turn-long bonus.
requirements: An eligible Ranger ally, distant state for ranged, Strides on the field to banish, and a legal further attack.
cautions: Second Wind targets allies, so a Ranger champion is not an eligible shared target. The pair does not make the ally distant.
Local catalog marks Ranger Strides STANDARD limit 0.

candidates.summary: An awake Concoction can place two buff counters on an ally and draw a card; Draught can wake that ally for another attack.
requirements: An ally, Concoction already awake, and both Potions available. Pay reserve costs or provide the separately listed Brew ingredients.
cautions: Concoction enters rested with Hindered. Draught targets an ally and cannot wake the Potion. This is not an immediate two-card loop.

candidates.summary: Dungeon Guide can level a champion, helping satisfy the two horses' Pride 3 requirement when the resulting champion is at least level 3.
requirements: Two cards in memory to banish, a compatible champion in material, and a resulting level sufficient for Pride.
cautions: Dungeon Guide is a normal-element, non-unique Human and does not itself meet either horse's unique-Human alternate condition.
The package does not itself establish access to both horse elements or a taxing effect.

Herb Burn.description: Preview shows two alternative packages: Tender + Rebuke, or Floral Arrangement + Combustible Potion. Matching requires either complete pair plus the Fire gate and exclusions; it does not require all four cards.
Herb Burn.decision: Show both alternative pairs as preview cards; preserve the OR-of-ALL matching rule.

Arcane Mage.description: Preview shows alternative signature cards, not a jointly required core. Matching requires at least one listed signature card and respects the source exclusions.
Arcane Mage.decision: Use source signature cards as display previews only. Keep the ANY rule and exclusions unchanged.

Psycho.description: Required Psycho + Monk pair with the Crux Lorraine parent gate preserved. The damage boost requires Psycho awake and another regalia paying the granted rest cost.
Psycho.decision: Use the source-required pair as core; retain conditional mechanics and parent dependency.

Crux Lorraine.decision: Use source signature cards as display previews only. Keep the ANY rule and exclusions unchanged.

publicationBase.decision: Use the unchanged live reference as the curator base. Adopt selected upstream definitions as custom curated rules, preserving upstream provenance. Do not replace broad live classifiers.
